scope: Replace the active feedback-authorized Session backend's historical Python SDK carrier with ctx.otel

paired.comparison: Actual Source and Native backend constructors over recording otel ports: mode/URL/batch/deadline admission and error precedence, forwarded reporter scope/resource/options, direct-record refusal, canonical feedback prefix authorization, inherited consent refusal and source-envelope/redaction behavior.
paired.peer_regression: rc022-client-peer-paired-20261116-01: 11 actual Source/Native shortcuts/document-preview Host configuration and peer-bearing index-injection cases, zero differences.

verification.native: Initial selected run: 90 passed and 2 Web HTML checks failed. After fixing the discovered injection callback arity, the two Web cases and actual Loader Host binding regression all passed (3 passed). No full collection/release claim is made by combining these runs.
verification.source: 87 passed across the pinned session-telemetry and session-telemetry-otel packages, plus the paired backend/Host observations above.
verification.scope_reason: Covers backend-owned policy/options/deadline, actual JSON collector output from live/forked/cold feedback, direct otel/channel consumers, CLI profile startup and actual Web provider startup/HTML/teardown.

behavior: The installation registry now resolves the active backend to telemetry_otel_current.CurrentOpenTelemetrySessionBackend with required sessions and otel services. The old SDK backend and historical coordinator fixtures remain separate historical helpers.

Canonical event envelopes excluding data are copied before redaction. Accepted bodies become the event data in complete Session-log content; removing sourceEvent withholds the record. Direct emit calls cannot authorize upload.

The new coordinator uses the Source message-level tool-result isError flag. Cold feedback restoration includes registered message projections. Reporter resource/scope identity uses the pinned 0.2.2-rc.3 package contract.
The backend's outer deadline calls stopPending and rejects while an unsettled transport remains owned by the reporter. It does not cancel or release that transport slot.

The base bundle now mounts otel and uses the exact Source otel/session-backend block, including the new collector endpoint and request byte ceiling. Required package dependencies and backend manifest are updated in the same contract change.

The actual Web resource passes a peer to index-injection listeners. Existing shortcuts/document-preview callbacks now accept this extra argument, matching JavaScript callback behavior. Failure diagnostics were added to the Web integration test.
diagnostics: An initial observer provenance collector tried to hash a prepared directory. The observer argument was changed to the identity file; the complete final comparison passed.

Two initial Web HTML failures were caused directly by single-argument injection lambdas receiving the peer argument. Raw profile warnings and failed-run logs are preserved. The same logs also expose pre-existing mixed profile stateVersion 3/2 modelSelection registrations and a missing old subagent row; those composition gaps remain for the coordinated bundle/profile migration.
limitations: The new paired backend cases use controlled reporter ports; actual Native JSON collector and profile cases cover composition, while existing service/channel pairs qualify their respective Source transports. These are distinct observations, not a new full acceptance receipt.

Historical live coordinator fixtures remain attached to their old contract. General v4 projection/loopless session ownership gaps and remaining bundle/profile/client promotion are separate pending work.
Existing TLS/Agent/SDK adaptation limits remain. Full migration/release, Portable/browser and Windows 7 qualification remain pending.

cleanup.retained: Commands, logs/XML/Vitest JSON, paired observations and hashes, and raw profile warning observations for the remaining composition gaps. Shared Source/toolchains remain needed for product-event consumer migration and C9.
